name: tinymoe.c
description: Bare-metal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts transformer in C99.
details: A bare-metal, dependency-free Sparse Mixture-of-Experts transformer written entirely in C99.
architecture: Tokenizer → Embed → Gating → Top-K Experts → Output
quip: No frameworks. No excuses. Just raw malloc, cache lines, and ambition.

name: ThreatWeave
description: High-throughput OCaml/C NIDS with hybrid DNN-GNN detection.
details: High-throughput Network Intrusion Detection System coupling functional OCaml 5 multicore domain orchestrators with low-level C fast-paths.
architecture: Packets → C Fast-Path → DNN-GNN → OCaml Orchestrator
quip: 99.64% accuracy. The remaining 0.36% keeps me awake in the lab.

name: PoisonIvy
description: Adversarial dataset poisoning framework for ML security research.
details: A configurable dataset-poisoning utility for adversarial machine-learning experiments and IDS benchmarking.
quip: Teaching neural nets that their training data is actively hostile.

name: MDCN-Military-Distributed-Communication-Network-
details: A local role-based communication simulation built around Solidity smart contracts and a React frontend.
quip: If one node gets wiped out, the topology doesn't flinch. As intended.

name: SyncStream-Encrypted-Multi-Device-CCTV-Protocol
details: A security-oriented control layer for multi-device video systems using authenticated encryption, payload validation, replay protection, and secure command handling.
quip: End-to-end encrypted, pthreads-isolated, clean valgrind memcheck.

name: Project_RedTooth
details: A Windows Bluetooth management utility separating native device operations from application-level logic.
architecture: Rust API → FFI → C++ Win32 → BT Stack
quip: Making Bluetooth slightly less painful, one memory-safe FFI at a time.

name: NexLog-Network-Extractor-And-Logger
description: Raw-socket network flow sensor with entropy-based detection.
details: A lightweight network-flow monitoring service using raw socket inspection, structured flow records, DNS extraction, telemetry, and heuristic anomaly detection.
quip: 100K packets/sec with zero drops. Shannon would approve.

name: DirectoryNator
details: A standard-library filesystem inventory and traversal utility supporting breadth-first search, depth-first search, Trie-based traversal, and multithreaded scanning.
quip: Because waiting for standard recursive tools is a waste of CPU cycles.

name: quartz
details: Quartz is a full-stack OCaml framework for reactive UI, server rendering, parameterized SQL, WebSocket and SSE streams, and 3D WebGL2/WebGPU scenes in one type-checked codebase.
quip: Because apparently OCaml needed a full-stack web framework.

name: quartz-pages
description: Quartz docs, showcase and full-stack sandbox.
details: A standalone documentation portal, component studio, multi-renderer explorer, and interactive full-stack sandbox built against the released Quartz OCaml framework.
quip: The framework needed a website. Naturally, it got an entire sandbox.
